lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is the joint Ouray County-City of Telluride Town Council session Tuesday, where a public hearing opens on extending a development vesting period — and separately, Ouray City and County sit down together Monday to work through a proposed intergovernmental agreement that would hand full law enforcement for the City over to the County Sheriff starting January 1, 2027, with public comment scheduled at 5:00 PM. San Miguel County's BOCC and Planning Commission also have public hearings on affordable housing fees and a code update, and Mountain Village spends all day Wednesday on its 2027 budget.

notable.stake: Public comment open on county taking over Ouray City law enforcement Jan. 2027.
